Chapter 6935: Private Viewing

Chapter 6935: Private Viewing

Treasure Immortal realm was a major firmament in Ancient World, capable of accommodating ten smaller ones.

Its massive territory was due to its master, Treasure Immortal Lord, the second immortal of his branch and the heir apparent.

Putting their blood ties aside, he had the most similar personality to Breaker Immortal. Although he wasn’t as merciless now, people thought it was only a matter of time.

Other immortals in the major worlds had no issue with this. After all, the duo had limited influence and only murdered weaker cultivators and mortals in minor worlds and firmaments. Thus, they weren’t a threat like Devouring Alliance.

Mortals were disposable, no different from ants. Killing ants was no crime in their eyes since they had done the same, only to a lesser extent.

Today, Treasure Immortal Lord held a private showing for immortals all around Heavenrealm. Most didn’t refuse because of his cruelty.

This viewing was held at periodic intervals. It could be millions of years or just a few hundred thousand years.

Everyone knew his hobby was collecting treasure, albeit in a more twisted way. For example, another immortal might prefer to collect ancient artifacts and metals, perhaps a rare immortal source.

More often than not, these treasures were related to resources or cultivation. Treasure Immortal Lord only collected to satisfy his obsession; his collectibles had a blood-soaked history behind them.

This was similar to how a mortal might collect insect corpses or pour molten aluminum into an ant nest.

Thus, some immortals were intrigued instead of being disgusted by it. Furthermore, since he was a golden immortal and his father was a primordial immortal, a few of his collections were indeed impressive.

Ample resources aside, he was talented and worked to get to his level. Not all children inherited their parents’ gift and tenacity for cultivation.

This private showing also served as a meeting event for trading and friendship building. It took place in Treasure Immortal Realm. All other beings were kicked out; overlords and above could stay to receive the guests. Only a few emperors and ancient ancestors had the honor of being servants.

Once it began, visual phenomena erupted everywhere. When immortals arrived, flowers and heavenly dew also emerged. Thus, those eligible to stay were rather lucky.

The guests came from all over Heavenrealm - Epoch Dawn, Golden World, Heavenly Fortress...

They were amazed to see his collection since he didn’t hold back. Some paid attention to the strange trinkets and random items. Some were worthless but had stories behind them.

One was an azure planet with a different path than cultivation. The inhabitants developed electricity, machines, and other technologies.

There were machines capable of flying and rolling on the ground. Tiny metals allowed them to communicate. They didn’t have a single cultivator among them.
